item.title: Edu
item.description: Somewhere around 2022. I do not paint much, but when I do I favour gouache because the logistics are simple compared to other mediums like oil. Gouache fits nicely in a busy life.

item.title: Model
item.description: I did a lot of conte drawings on newsprint paper in the 2017->2021 era, at the time I was pushing hard to get good at portraiture. This one is from the later stages of the grind.

item.title: Wolf
item.description: Experimenting with toned paper and using white pencil. Intended to be just an exercise, ended up gifting this one to a friend who said they liked it. Must have been around 2023.
